My main focus is web development, with hands-on work in backend systems, databases, AI, and computer vision. fields.title: TIMBLE
fields.description: A timetable planning workspace for subject offerings, open sections, and class schedules. It uses historical enrollment and curriculum data to suggest suitable section numbers. The idea: make academic planning easier to see, adjust, and act on.

fields.title: Garbage Intensification
fields.description: Analyzes hourly snapshots from community CCTV cameras to estimate garbage buildup by area and help local governments manage waste. I worked on the backend and model training.

fields.title: EduTrack
fields.description: A university student performance tracking system designed to make academic progress easier to monitor. A clearer view of how students are doing.

fields.title: Printing Section System
fields.description: Helped digitize print requests, cost computation, and transaction logging for the university printing section. A smoother path from request to record.

fields.title: Face Recognition Attendance
fields.description: An attendance system that identifies students by face and records attendance automatically.

fields.title: Top 25 Qualifier, Philippine Startup Challenge XI
fields.description: Our TIMBLE team qualified for the Central Visayas Top 25 of the Philippine Startup Challenge XI and participated in the Regional Pitching Competition on October 24, 2026. TIMBLE x University of San Jose-Recoletos.
